name: Protein-Reader-DEMO
description: Protein structure analysis & 3D visualization web app (Flask + 3Dmol.js) - parse PDB/FASTA/PDF, interactive 3D viewer, rule-based structure Q&A agent

paragraphs: Upload a protein structure file (.pdb / .fasta / .pdf), parse it, explore it in interactive 3D, and ask questions about it in natural language.

A Flask web app that parses molecular structure files and renders them as an interactive 3D model in the browser (via 3Dmol.js). It also includes a lightweight, rule-based Q&A agent that answers questions about the loaded structure (chains, residues, molecule summary) — no external LLM or API keys required.
🧬 Demonstration prototype. Uploaded files are processed locally and are not committed to this repository.
features: Multi-format parsing — .pdb (Protein Data Bank), .fasta (sequences), and .pdf (text extraction via pdfplumber).
Interactive 3D viewer — rotate / zoom / style protein structures in the browser with 3Dmol.js.
Structure Q&A agent — ask natural-language questions (e.g. "how many chains?", "summarize the molecules") answered by a deterministic keyword-scoring agent.
Clean web UI — Bootstrap 5 single-page interface.
Cloud-ready — Azure infrastructure (Bicep) + azd config, plus gunicorn/nginx/systemd deployment files.
